title: McDonald's & Disney "101 DALMATIONS" 1996 DOG SLEDDING Snow Globe Dome In Box
descriptionText: The product is a McDonald's & Disney 1996 "101 DALMATIONS" Dog Sled Snow Globe Dome in its original box. This collectible features a cute scene from the Disney movie "101 Dalmations" with a dog sled being pulled by two Dalmatians. The snow globe was manufactured in China and is a part of the Disney franchise, making it a sought-after item for Disney collectors and fans of the iconic film.
